title: Disjointification of countably many injectively parametrised Borel pieces (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.3)
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ. For j ∈ ℕ let ψ_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^P be continuous and Y_j ⊆ ℝ^N Borel with ψ_j injective on Y_j. Then there are Borel sets Y'_j ⊆ Y_j (j ∈ ℕ) such that the images ψ_j(Y'_j) are pairwise disjoint and ⋃_j ψ_j(Y'_j) = ⋃_j ψ_j(Y_j).
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid P) (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid N)), (∀ j, Continuous (ψ j)) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j)) → (∀ j, InjOn (ψ j) (Y j)) → ∃ Y' : ℕ → Set (Euclid N), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y' j) ∧ Y' j ⊆ Y j) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y' i) (ψ j '' Y' j)) ∧ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y' j = ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j
